docs.text: If you ever visit the shore of Lake Erie, you *must* try the lobster roll.
Wife just informed me “we have to move to Maine because there are no lobsters in the Great Lakes.”
The Great Lakes have Crayfish which are just mini lobsters and we know how much New Englanders lover their lobster.
I'm just glad I'm not from Tennessee. I guess I'll eat my famous Great Lakes lobster rolls.
Lake fish is fair game in the Great Lakes region! But not lobster.

Nirav Shah is from #Wisconsin so maybe he understands a little more of #Maine seafood culture than I do (they do have good Lake Michigan whitefish in Door County), but you’d get blank stares from me if I get quizzed on different types of New England #lobster 😂
Maybe he’ll stick to public health
I'd very much like to get lobsters in Lake Superior so we could have a fight with coastal Maine

They were surprisingly common, although I don't think I ever knew anyone who bought one. Definitely weird to think about, since the closest significant body of water was Lake Erie 3+ hours away, and I don't think lobsters live in /any/ of the Great Lakes
(quickly checks the internet to see if lobsters live in Lake Michigan) That can't be a very fresh lobster in Chicago at that price, either!

A lobster roll restaurant opened this month in Olcott along Lake Ontario. Owner Michelle Pozantides imports the lobster from Maine, double-toasts the brioche roll and makes her own clarified butter and lemon chive mayo.
Not queuing up for a Lake Ontario Lobster roll anytime soon.
